Step 1: 1394-07-11 minus 293 days.  
Step 2: 1394 is a common year (not divisible by 4 in Gregorian).  
Step 3: Subtract 293 days:  
- Back 184 days to 1394-01-08 (from July 11).  
- Remaining 109 days earlier into 1393.  
- 1393 is common year, so 109 days before 1394-01-08 is 1393-09-21.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1393-09-21
